run_mixin_prepare_rollout: run the _maybe_prepare_rollout method to prepare the denoising loop for rollout
run_mixin_collect_log_probs: run the _maybe_collect_rollout_log_probs method to collect rollout log probabilities from the scheduler
run_mixin_postprocess_outputs: run the _postprocess_rollout_outputs method to finalize rollout-only outputs after denoising
run_mixin_init_env_collection: run the _maybe_init_denoising_env_collection method to initialize denoising environment state for trajectory collection
run_mixin_finalize_collection: run the _maybe_finalize_dit_env_collection method to finalize and store the denoising environment and trajectory data
